# AEGIS / HATHOR Architecture Corpus

> Governance and control-plane design for the HATHOR agentic application framework.

New identifiers: decisions `TS3-D-###`, components `TS3-C-###`, interfaces `TS3-I-###` (namespaced to avoid collision with TS-001/TS-002).
